title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and persists in a population during an infectious disease outbreak, influenced by social networks, policies, messaging, enforcement, and supply constraints, and assess resulting epidemiological and behavioral outcomes.

interactions.name: ContactTransmission
interactions.description: People co-located generate contacts; infection transmission probability is modulated by mask use of source and recipient, location risk, and base transmission.

interactions.name: SocialInfluenceOnAdoption
interactions.description: Individuals update mask use propensity based on neighbors’ observed behavior and perceived social norms.

interactions.name: PolicyComplianceAndEnforcement
interactions.description: Mask mandates at locations trigger compliance decisions; authorities or location staff may enforce via warnings or fines.

interactions.name: InformationBroadcast
interactions.description: HealthAuthority and MediaChannel disseminate messages that adjust individuals’ risk perception and trust, affecting adoption.

interactions.name: MaskProcurement
interactions.description: People buy masks from retailers subject to price, availability, and personal budget; stockouts constrain adoption.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of people wearing masks at each time step; can be disaggregated by location or subgroup.

metrics.name: steady_state_adoption
metrics.description: Average mask adoption over the final evaluation window to assess long-run behavior.

metrics.name: infection_incidence
metrics.description: New infections per day and cumulative infections over time.

metrics.name: effective_reproduction_number_Rt
metrics.description: Estimated Rt derived from infection chains or incidence; reflects transmission under current behaviors.

metrics.name: policy_compliance_rate
metrics.description: Share of individuals complying with mask mandates when present.

metrics.name: enforcement_actions
metrics.description: Number and rate of warnings/fines issued per day.

metrics.name: mask_stockouts_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of retailers with zero inventory; duration and frequency of stockouts.

metrics.name: time_to_target_adoption
metrics.description: Days required to reach a specified adoption threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_gini
metrics.description: Inequality in adoption across demographic or income groups measured by Gini coefficient or similar.

metrics.name: cost_burden_share_of_income
metrics.description: Average mask expenditure as a fraction of individual income among adopters.

metrics.name: risk_perception_average
metrics.description: Population mean of perceived risk over time.
